technology_name: A SYSTEM FOR REMOTE REAL TIME CONDITION MONITORING OF MULTI-LEVEL INVERTERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Industrial Telemetry Unit / Inverter Diagnostic Hardware
problem_solved: High-power multi-level inverters used in remote solar farms or plants can experience sudden component faults without notice, leading to extended operational downtime and expensive repair cascades.
description: An integrated IoT monitoring system containing a dedicated analog-to-digital data engine, an edge-computing Raspberry Pi 3 B+ microprocessor, and a multi-level Neutral Point Clamped (NPC) inverter network backed by a Spartan-6 FPGA board running a 10 kHz switching logic.
applications: Renewable energy solar inverter farms, industrial manufacturing plant power lines, high-voltage DC transmission substations, and smart grid sub-stations.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
